notFound.heading: We can't find that page
notFound.lead: The link may be old, or the page may have moved. Search for a builder, or go back to where you were.

serverError.title: Something went wrong · Banaro
serverError.heading: Something went wrong on our side
serverError.lead: It isn't you. Try again in a moment; your profile and messages are safe.

maintenance.title: Down for maintenance · Banaro
maintenance.heading: Down for a short maintenance
maintenance.leadAt: We're tending to Banaro and expect to be back by {time} Eastern. Nothing is lost. Thank you for your patience.
maintenance.lead: We're tending to Banaro and expect to be back soon. Nothing is lost. Thank you for your patience.

offline.title: You're offline · Banaro
offline.heading: You're offline
offline.lead: Banaro can't reach the internet right now. Check your connection; we will reconnect on our own and keep what you were writing. Nothing is sent until you send it.

forbidden.title: No access · Banaro
forbidden.heading: This one isn't yours to open
forbidden.lead: You don't have access to this page. If you think that's a mistake, let us know and we will take a look.
